brief: Build a debt inventory containing balances, costs, deadlines and stated consequences.

title.es-MX: Pon cada deuda en una lista

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Put every debt on one list"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Pon cada deuda en una lista"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Ponha cada dívida numa lista"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Build a debt inventory containing balances, costs, deadlines and stated consequences.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A repayment plan needs verified balances, costs, deadlines and consequences.
instruction.misconception: Planning from whichever debt is most noticeable while omitting other balances, due dates or consequences.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: List each creditor, current balance, payment due, date, costs and stated consequences. Check records before deciding what to pay.
Amounts without dates cannot show when cash must be available.
Different notices can describe the same underlying obligation.
Dates and intervening payments or charges explain what needs reconciliation.
Total balance and currently required payment answer different questions.
Costs, timing and consequences affect the next feasible action.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
